method: Bounded read-only source review, supplemented by existing playback-validation output. No GPU jobs or production changes were performed during integration review.
verifiedByInspection: Willis and Millennium share world identity and ChicagoWorld scene construction. The controller reuses the resident renderer/BVH when changing between them.
The dedicated Chicago flight action selects view 7, preserves the selected lighting and starts playback.
Timeline seeking, shuttle advancement and endpoint clamping read the selected view duration, including the 240-second connecting flight.
Single-view CLI export defaults to the selected duration; final-frame interpolation includes the exact route endpoint. Multi-view montage intentionally compresses each route into one chapter.
CameraTrack uses ordered keys and monotone coordinate tangents. The authored Millennium keys are strictly ordered and position/target continuity is preserved.
Existing playback tests cover the 240-second clock, 75% seek, shuttle endpoint, returning to 56-second views, shared-world identity, idle lighting cycles and sampled route clearance.

minorDocumentationFinding.description: Help paragraph still calls every selected walkthrough 56 seconds; the connecting Chicago flight is 240 seconds. Reported to parent for its UI/docs pass.

limitations: This review does not replace native UI verification, which the parent owns.
No new full playback validation run was started here; the existing report was read.
Motion quality and final GPU performance are being assessed separately.
